nodes.label: NotBuilt page
nodes.rationale: Names the sub-project that brings a view not built in this build.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme script (qnipay.theme)
nodes.rationale: Applies the dark theme from localStorage before first paint, sign-in included, so a dark-theme user never sees a white flash. The shell's theme toggle (src/shell/Shell.tsx) writes the same key.

nodes.label: Delivery plans 1a / 1b / 1c
nodes.rationale: 1a foundation and access; 1b people, dimensions, employee types, self-service; 1c configuration and communication. Audit and access come first because every later write depends on them.

nodes.label: --qp design tokens (ui/tokens.css)
nodes.rationale: Three-tier stylesheet lifted verbatim from the prototype including the dark theme; Tailwind theme maps to it so shadcn renders in Qnipay colours, Inter and the 4px grid.

nodes.label: Seed extraction from the prototype
nodes.rationale: Prototype keeps data in a closure, so a script loads it in jsdom, signs in and reads its localStorage store; no sample data is retyped. Output committed as src/mocks/seed/*.json for qnipay and social tenants.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui on Radix
nodes.rationale: Matches the Dogma HIG (itself shadcn/Radix); Radix supplies focus management, keyboard and ARIA.

nodes.label: Sub-projects 1-7 (Foundation, Timesheet, Rota, Leave, Onboarding, Payroll/BC, Production swap)
nodes.norm_label: sub-projects 1-7 (foundation, timesheet, rota, leave, onboarding, payroll/bc, production swap)
nodes.rationale: Rota before Leave, as in PRD section 13. Each sub-project gets its own spec and plan.

nodes.label: Qnipay v15 prototype (qnipay-workforce-v15.html)
nodes.rationale: Behavioural and visual reference implementation, read-only, at ../Qnipay workforce cc/mockup/.

nodes.label: Plan 1a: Foundation and Access
nodes.rationale: A running React app signing in as employee, manager or admin, capability-driven navigation, editable permissions with per-user exceptions, audit log, all via typed contract answered by MSW. 11 tasks.

nodes.label: Sub-project 1 design: Foundation and Workforce core
nodes.norm_label: sub-project 1 design: foundation and workforce core
nodes.rationale: Rebuild Qnipay Workforce as React in stages against a fake API shaped like the real one, so application code does not change at the swap.

nodes.label: Qnipay Workforce React app
nodes.rationale: Workforce management for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central: timesheet, rota, leave and payroll hand-off over one shared workforce record. Runs against an MSW fake API replaced endpoint by endpoint.

nodes.label: Server helpers: refuse, readJson, requireSession, requireCapability, checkVersion, bump
nodes.norm_label: server helpers: refuse, readjson, requiresession, requirecapability, checkversion, bump

nodes.label: Audit log (iaudit)
nodes.rationale: Handler writes one audit row per state change: who, what, before -> after, and why where required.

nodes.label: Optimistic concurrency (version, If-Match, 412)
nodes.rationale: Every record carries id, version, updatedAt; writes send If-Match; stale gets 412, mirroring Business Central etags.

nodes.label: Per-user grants and revocations
nodes.rationale: New relative to the prototype (which holds only emp/mgr/adm columns); built from the CLAUDE.md access model, read as 'Manager + 2 exceptions'; trace rows n/a (not in prototype).

nodes.label: Module review priorities
nodes.rationale: Ordered: 1 permission and money paths (capability checks in handlers, scope leaks, view-as writes, self-approval, 412/409 refusals); 2 data integrity (one audit row per mutation, no optimistic updates, no money fields, masking); 3 tests that pass with the feature broken; 4 divergences from mockup slices; 5 brief constraints.

nodes.label: Plan 1a Review Focus (five risks)
nodes.rationale: Stale write from two tabs (412); revoking your own way back (perm_cfg lock); store written by an older seed; session whose account was removed; fault on a write leaving UI and store unchanged (breaks optimistic updates).

nodes.label: Rules live on the server side (handlers call domain/)
nodes.norm_label: rules live on the server side (handlers call domain/)
nodes.rationale: Client never enforces a rule the server does not also enforce; client validation only repeats a server rule for fast feedback. UI reports success only from the response.

nodes.label: Wrapped UI components with required testId, toastRefusal, expectTestIdCoverage
nodes.norm_label: wrapped ui components with required testid, toastrefusal, expecttestidcoverage

nodes.label: No monetary fields / money lint
nodes.rationale: Schema lint fails on fields named amount, price, salary, wage, grossPay, netPay, rateValue or currency symbols; exceptions go in contract/money-lint.allow.json with a reason.

nodes.label: Refusal shape {code, message, next, usedBy?, field?}
nodes.norm_label: refusal shape {code, message, next, usedby?, field?}
nodes.rationale: 403 capability, 409 in use or illegal transition, 412 stale, 422 validation. Toasts show message and next, enforcing the house rule that a refusal states consequence and what to do next.

nodes.label: Test ID registry (src/testids.ts, data-testid)
nodes.rationale: One typed registry shared by components and Playwright; format area-element[-recordId]; never contains display text so renaming a label never breaks a test; wrapped components require a testId prop.

nodes.label: Zod contract and OpenAPI output
nodes.rationale: Single contract used by client, fake server and generated contract/openapi.json, the draft API spec for the production team. REST under /api/v1; state changes are explicit endpoints, never a PATCH of a state field.

nodes.label: 1a porting patterns
nodes.rationale: Contracts via defineEndpoint, handlers through serve(), writes through useRecordMutation, screens from src/ui and the shared page frame, tid test IDs. Real code wins over any draft.

nodes.label: Rules carried from the product
nodes.rationale: Workforce never resolves money (posts hours and a pay code; BC owns value); codes unique on create and immutable after; nothing in use can be deleted and the refusal names what uses it; every state change audited; never claim an unobserved outcome (queued is queued); stubs labelled as stubs.

nodes.label: /api/_dev endpoints (reset, seed, clock, faults)
nodes.rationale: Development and test endpoints excluded from production builds, used to reset, seed tenants, freeze the clock and inject faults.

nodes.label: MSW fake server with in-memory store
nodes.norm_label: msw fake server with in-memory store
nodes.rationale: Persisted to localStorage under a seed version; an older seed version is set aside, never half-loaded.

nodes.label: Testing layers (domain, contract, component, e2e)
nodes.rationale: Vitest for domain and contract, Testing Library for components, Playwright Chromium for e2e, plus axe, 390px phone and visual baseline checks.

nodes.label: Port-mode test depth rule
nodes.rationale: Domain unit tests for every rule; full refusal and fault tests only on permission and money paths; one happy path plus one refusal elsewhere; one component test per screen. Thinner tests to speed porting.

nodes.label: End-to-end test rules
nodes.rationale: beforeEach resets and freezes clock; read the record back after actions; refusal tests prove nothing changed; every mutation has a fault test; no fixed sleeps.

nodes.label: One boundary: features call api/ only, api/ speaks HTTP only
nodes.norm_label: one boundary: features call api/ only, api/ speaks http only
nodes.rationale: MSW answers behind HTTP and can be switched off one endpoint at a time, enabling the production swap.

nodes.label: Prototype trace (e2e/trace.json)
nodes.rationale: One row per prototype suite assertion with status ported / n/a / pending; ported tests keep the prototype's text; CI fails if a completed plan's row is pending.

nodes.label: mockup-slicer agent
nodes.rationale: Extracts one module's screens from the v15 prototype into small slice files once, so porters and reviewers do not re-read the whole mockup. Copy, never paraphrase.

nodes.label: trace-filler agent
nodes.rationale: Mechanical (sonnet) agent that fills a finished module's e2e/trace.json rows as ported (exact grepped test title), n/a (prototype-only or replaced-by reason) or deferredTo, adds the area to completedAreas and runs trace:check until it passes. Never edits app code or tests.

nodes.label: Mockup slices (.superpowers/sdd/<module>/slices/<screen>.md)
nodes.rationale: Each slice holds the screen's render markup, CSS rules, handlers and data fields, suite assertions (all verbatim) and a list of states (empty, error, refused, per persona).

nodes.label: Module review file (review.md)
nodes.rationale: Verdict (ready / ready after fixes / not ready), verify result, findings by severity Critical/Important/Minor.

nodes.label: Module condensed brief (brief.md)
nodes.rationale: Binding per-module brief at .superpowers/sdd/<module>/brief.md, including a Review Focus list.

nodes.label: Module report (report.md)
nodes.rationale: One section per task (what was built, tests, departures with reasons) plus a current Next section for hand-off between agents.

nodes.label: module-reviewer agent
nodes.rationale: The one strongest-model (opus) review per module in port mode; read-only on source, writes only its review file, runs npm run verify once, reports only confirmed findings with file:line and scenario.

nodes.label: porter agent
nodes.rationale: Ports one task group of a module from the v15 prototype into the React app using the 1a patterns; reads brief, then slices, then the report's Next section; commits per task, never pushes or merges.
